name: Formal Occasion

intent_defaults.description: A formal or occasionwear direction with user-controlled structure, drape, detail density and event-specific styling.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-selected structured, fluid or sculptural silhouette.

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: Formal and ceremonial value is user-defined and is not penalized for low wear frequency.
Drape, support, transparency and embellishment require material and construction validation.
